append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1630). PREMISE HELD at 682e88b46 (LIVE-701's branch over main 3be160428): nothing handled beforeinstallprompt and public/manifest.json (static, pointed at by app/layout.tsx metadata; nothing generates it) shipped "screenshots": []. WHAT CHANGED, per the owner's "After first RSVP" ruling. (1) lib/pwa/install-capture.ts, a leaf, exports INSTALL_CAPTURE_SCRIPT, inlined in the root <head>: it preventDefaults beforeinstallprompt (so Chrome's own first-visit install bar stays off), holds the event on window for a tap, clears it on appinstalled, and stamps the device's first visit (frequency.firstSeen in localStorage plus a session flag, capped at 12 hours). (2) components/push/install.ts: pure installAvailability (installed, prompt, ios-steps, none) over LIVE-701's readPushEnv, isFirstVisit, nudgeOffer, and promptInstallFromTap, which fires prompt() before its first await and releases the one-shot event. (3) ONE card: DeviceNudge (components/push/device-nudge.tsx) replaces LIVE-701's PushNudge under a Going RSVP and in a Circle, and renders after a post in every Composer (next/dynamic, the composer is in the (main) shell graph). It offers install only after an RSVP or a post, never on a first visit, once per device (frequency.installNudge), and push when a tap can ask (frequency.pushNudge); both share the card; the first eligible card on a load claims the only slot. An iPhone Safari tab gets the three Share, Add to Home Screen steps and no button, and is told notifications work from there; that card obeys the install rules. (4) Settings has a permanent "Install the app" section (#install) with InstallSettingsCard. (5) The manifest lists /screenshots/home-narrow.jpg (390x844, narrow) and /screenshots/home-wide.jpg (1264x800, wide), real crops of the repo's visual baselines of the public home page (signed-in captures are masked). Help: content/help/getting-started/install-the-app.md. TESTS: install.test.ts, device-nudge.test.tsx, install-card.test.tsx. Mutation-checked in the suite (first visit, Circle context, preventDefault, await before prompt, one claim per load, iOS steps, once per device each fail a test). No migration.
